reference.capture: tmux capture-pane -p after each stable redraw

normalization: Capture only stable terminal text and interaction markers; ANSI sequences, cursor placement, colors, and trailing spaces are not part of this contract.
Each scenario uses a fresh synthetic HERMES_HOME with a loopback custom provider and no listening model endpoint; no provider response or private state is copied.
Dynamic session IDs, elapsed seconds, temporary checkout paths, and rotating prompt suggestions are omitted or represented by placeholders.
The rotating busy face is normalized to the busy state; the interrupt affordance is the stable busy marker.
Input bytes are recorded in hexadecimal after tmux key translation; wait events represent the debounce or redraw window and have no input bytes.
The contract records observed reference behavior only. It does not imply that Hades implements any of these interactions yet.
